description: Per-repo named required checks for the agent-review gate (slice 3 final, per v4-execution/agent-review-decisions.md D1). A listed check must be present with status COMPLETED and conclusion SUCCESS, otherwise the verdict is BLOCKED. autonomous-venture-company has an EMPTY pin set (no CI): it stays BLOCKED with EMPTY_PIN_SET unless the explicit owner-override label OWNER_OVERRIDE_ACCEPT_RISK is present (see docs/agent-review.md). Unknown repos fail closed with POLICY_UNKNOWN_REPO.
